verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an LLM tracing and observability service that stores user traces. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, retention settings, or deletion of traces or data. The Service API and OpenAPI items describe general programmatic access, and the only endpoints they name are /call/start and /calls/stream_query, neither of which concerns deletion or retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
